name: project-panel
description: A side pane for any repo with a plan: sections, items and what blocks the next one. Providers: AI-DLC v2, and a task ledger (WORKPLAN.md) read against its pull or merge requests (GitHub through gh, GitLab through glab, self-hosted included), with each pull request's review state.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: auto: open the pane by itself when a plan is detected (desktop app only), /panel opens it anywhere. command: open it only with /panel or a button. off: never open it.

stageBranchPattern.title: Stage branch pattern (AI-DLC)
stageBranchPattern.description: AI-DLC provider. Regex for the branch of a stage's pull request; named groups `ticket` and `stages`, used to map pull requests onto stages. Whether a session is a stage or a side job is decided by its AI-DLC binding, not its branch. Set it to empty to map no pull requests.

foldSeparator.title: Fold separator (AI-DLC)
foldSeparator.description: AI-DLC provider. Separates stage slugs in a branch that carries several stages at once (dev/SHOP-7/refined-mockups--domain-design).

forge.title: Forge
forge.description: Where pull or merge requests are read from. auto: github.com is GitHub; any other host is GitLab when glab is logged in to it, GitHub Enterprise when gh is. github / gitlab: take the origin's host as that forge without probing. none: read no pull or merge requests (progress comes from the ledger alone).

reviewCommands.title: Review commands
reviewCommands.description: Whether Needs attention and Next name the pr-review plugin's commands (/pr-review:review-pr N, /pr-review:address-review N, /pr-review:request-review N). auto: when the repository's .claude/settings.json enables a pr-review plugin. on: always. off: never (the review state still shows).

slackDomain.title: Slack workspace domain
slackDomain.description: The Slack workspace's domain, the part before .slack.com (acme for acme.slack.com). With it, a PR's pr-review Slack thread is a link; without it the panel only shows that the thread exists. No Slack call is ever made.

fsPollSeconds.title: File poll (seconds)
fsPollSeconds.description: How often the open pane checks the plan's files and the git branch for changes made outside the session. Minimum 2; 0 turns the poll off (tool calls, turn ends and Refresh still re-read).

prPollSeconds.title: Remote poll (seconds)
prPollSeconds.description: How often the open pane asks a provider whether its remote state (pull or merge requests) changed. Minimum 30; 0 turns the poll off. AI-DLC asks too: its stages are read against the default branch and the open pull or merge requests (a repo with no origin is never asked). A provider with no remote state is never asked.

summaryModel.title: Enrichment model
summaryModel.description: Full model id for side-job titles, captions and session summaries (milestone 4+). A full id, not the `haiku` alias: the alias resolves to whatever the engine's table says, which may be an older Haiku.
